objective: Forward-only verified progressive mutual support: qualified unique likes and distributed comments lift creator BP; genuinely reacted-to comments can earn BP; legitimate 3-user threaded discussions earn capped chain BP; preserve existing BCU/QMP and never block conversation.
productionBaselineEvidence: Read-only live Supabase BUKLOD Connect Nov 11 2026: active r37_standard_social_points_v1, active community_qmp_v1, comments/reactions/comment_reactions tables and triggers verified. This is code-level evidence, not OTA release proof.
chosenApproach: Add gated private Postgres functions/triggers and versioned successor to R37 creator impact settlement, with source-key idempotency, no payouts or direct user execution; update existing Points guide. No new app or native permissions.
selectionRationale: Use qualified R37 event ledger (not raw counts), reuse pre-existing creator tier and QMP authoritative sources, provide monotonic total rather than stacking independent bonus ledgers.
alternativeApproaches: Add separate creator bonus ledgers without R37 reconciliation rejected (double-credit at tier upgrades)
Block comments after cap rejected (kills social engagement)
preserveBehaviors: All posts/comments/replies remain possible at daily BP limit
Existing R37 BCU and QMP economic writes unchanged
No new production OTA or payout activation
Feature flag default disabled pending verified RC
acceptanceChecks: Qualify counts by R37 verified events, one unique like per actor and at most three counted comments per actor/post/day
Combined creator BP target max(5+milestones,R37 impact tier), monotonic and capped 600 per post
Commenter milestone +2/+5/+10 total, max 20 helpful bonus BP per user/day
Support chain requires 3 qualified comments, 2 distinct noncreator members and actual reply to another member; maximum 5 participants/chain, 2 rewarded chains/day/user
New rewards respect 60 BP/day and 300 BP/rolling-week availability gate
No extra QMP, BCU or money credits
RLS/private grants and old-client compatibility validated
